title: fumaria muralis var. affinis
intro: Fumaria muralis var. affinis, commonly known as Wall Fumitory, is a plant species belonging to the Fumariaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Wall Fumitory include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, respiratory infections, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Wall Fumitory include alkaloids, such as protopine and berberine, which exhibit therapeutic actions, including spasmolytic, diuretic, and vasodilatory effects.
